title: Picking the Right Image to Classify: Reliable-Input Selection in Teledermatology
abstract: arXiv:2608.16198v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dermatology models face distribution shifts in teledermatology settings, where submitted images differ from the training data in lighting, angle, distance, focus, and framing. These test-time images are ordinary clinical photographs, but some fall outside the model's training conditions, leading the model to often misclassify them due to shifts in acquisition between training and deployment. When multiple images of the same case exist (several photos of one patient or lesion), a natural way to improve accuracy is therefore to select the image the model is most likely to classify correctly. We call this task reliable-input selection. An oracle that, for each case, selects a correctly classified image when one exists raises weighted F1 by about 20 percentage points on average across six dermatology datasets and nine frozen backbones. translated_title: 选择正确的图像进行分类：远程皮肤病学中的可靠输入选择
translated_abstract: 皮肤病学模型在远程皮肤病学环境中面临分布偏移，其中提交的图像在光照、角度、距离、对焦和取景方面与训练数据不同。这些测试时的图像是普通的临床照片，但有些超出了模型的训练条件，导致模型常因训练与部署之间的采集差异而错误分类。当同一病例存在多张图像时（例如一个患者或病变的多张照片），提高准确率的自然方式是选择模型最有可能正确分类的图像。我们将此任务称为可靠输入选择。一个理想的“神谕”选择器，若每个病例存在一张正确分类的图像，则选择它，在六个皮肤病学数据集和九个冻结骨干网络上，平均加权F1分数提高约20个百分点。该神谕是能看到标签的上界，而实际选择器必须盲目选择。捕捉这一…
tldr: 本文提出“可靠输入选择”任务，通过在多张临床图像中挑选模型最可能正确分类的图像，显著提升远程皮肤病学分类准确性，平均加权F1提升约20个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the task of reliable-input selection, which improves teledermatology classification accuracy by picking the image most likely to be correctly classified among multiple clinical photos, boosting weighted F1 by about 20 points on average.
